name: desktop
title: UK PAYE Tax Calculator 2026-27 | HMRC Rates | PayeTax
inputGuidance: Enter your contribution, including net pay or relief at source. We estimate all contributions as salary sacrifice, so take-home may be too high. £ amounts are for your selected pay period. Switching between % and £ resets this field to 0.
disclosure: We use salary-sacrifice calculations, reducing the pay used for Income Tax, employee National Insurance and student loan repayments. Net pay and relief at source aren't calculated separately, so take-home may be too high. Employer NI stays based on gross employment pay; savings aren't included.
tooltipText:
Pension
Enter your contribution even for net pay or relief at source. Use % of gross salary or £ per pay period.
All contributions are estimated as salary sacrifice, so take-home may be too high. Open 'How pension affects your estimate' for the assumptions.
resultNote: All pension contributions are estimated as salary sacrifice. Net pay or relief at source may give overstated take-home. Employer NI excludes salary-sacrifice savings.
faqText: Income Tax, National Insurance, student loan repayments and pension contributions, broken down by pay period. Enter your pension contribution even for net pay or relief at source; we estimate it as salary sacrifice, which may overstate take-home. Pension arrangements explained.
